scope: source-only cross-review of the mean/logvariance objective and warm-start output extension
review_findings: The two logvariance rows append after the existing output rows. Main outputs and auxiliary offsets remain unchanged; mean-variance controls allocate the same rows, and their WMSE path reads only the first two outputs, so variance-row gradients are zero within the shared final Linear parameter rather than None.

For the fixed 0.9 teacher / 0.1 clipped-label recipe, WMSE and NLL use the same blended target and the original abs(clipped label) times validity weights. Both divide by the same sum of weights. NLL uses bounded logvariance [-4,4] and reduces to the same weighted squared-error scalar at zero logvariance.

Warm-start mapping copies the parent's full existing input projection and output rows, zeroes the added representation input columns and variance output rows, preserves means/scales for the original 211 inputs, and sets appended input means/scales to 0/1. The resulting 23-output-plus-two-row synthetic case preserves all original predictions.

The CLI configuration check requires a teacher, alpha 0.9, no far-alpha/bootstrap/reanchor, and cache scale 1. It does not itself prove that the supplied teacher artifact is the specific MainT3 checkpoint. The launch recipe must bind and verify that teacher/cache identity externally before training.
execution_scope: No data, checkpoint, model fit, or held-out scoring was performed by this review.
